description: VIEW/MATERIALIZED VIEW/REFRESH acceptance on postgresql17 (#123): view lifecycle incl. WITH CHECK OPTION, materialized view storage and refresh variants execute natively.

ddl_steps.name: base table
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t40.users (id bigint PRIMARY KEY, email text, age int); INSERT INTO t40.users VALUES (1,'a@x',30),(2,'b@x',40)

ddl_steps.name: create view
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE VIEW t40.adults AS SELECT id, email FROM t40.users WHERE age >= 18

ddl_steps.name: create view check option
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE VIEW t40.adults_co AS SELECT id, email FROM t40.users WHERE age >= 18 WITH CHECK OPTION

ddl_steps.name: create or replace view
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW t40.adults AS SELECT id, email, age FROM t40.users WHERE age >= 18

ddl_steps.name: create temp view
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW t40_tv AS SELECT 1 AS one

ddl_steps.name: alter view rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER VIEW t40.adults RENAME TO adults_v2

ddl_steps.name: alter view owner/schema
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE ROLE t40_owner LOGIN; ALTER VIEW t40.adults_v2 OWNER TO t40_owner; ALTER VIEW t40.adults_v2 SET SCHEMA public

ddl_steps.name: drop view
ddl_steps.sql: DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.adults_v2, t40.adults_co CASCADE

ddl_steps.name: create materialized view
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW t40.mv AS SELECT id, email FROM t40.users

ddl_steps.name: create materialized view no data
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW t40.mv_nd AS SELECT id FROM t40.users WITH NO DATA

ddl_steps.name: refresh concurrently
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX t40_mv_id ON t40.mv (id); REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY t40.mv

ddl_steps.name: alter materialized view rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW t40.mv RENAME TO mv2

ddl_steps.name: alter materialized view depends on extension
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW t40.mv2 DEPENDS ON EXTENSION pg_stat_statements

ddl_steps.name: drop materialized view
ddl_steps.sql: DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS t40.mv2, t40.mv_nd CASCADE

ddl_steps.name: drop schema
ddl_steps.sql: DROP SCHEMA t40 CASCADE; DROP ROLE t40_owner
